title: ADWTAG_60000 - Big R Radio - We’ll Be Right Back After This Message

lines.l: My career, my marriage, I owe to the Adult Literacy Center and my teachers.
They were with me every step of the way, helping with my English and math,
making sure I pushed through all the challenges.
Ariel, your success proves that what I'm doing as a teacher has real meaning.
It was an honor helping you achieve your greatness.
Now you're helping others achieve theirs.
Education was the key that unlocked all my opportunities.
Find free and supportive adult education centers near you at finishyourdiploma.org.
Brought to you by Dollar General Literacy Foundation and the Ad Council.
From the decade that perfected metal, this is 80s Metal FM on Big R Radio.
